selection_rationale: Selection uses only the complete 91000-91099 navigation results. The high-performing region comprises 220k (86/100), 240k (85/100), and 280k (88/100); the paired 220k-to-240k success difference is -1 percentage point with a 95% bootstrap interval of [-11, 8], consistent with a local plateau. The 260k checkpoint dips to 75/100, but 280k recovers to 88/100 with a paired +13-point difference versus 260k (95% interval [3, 23]). The 300k checkpoint gives no further gain: success falls to 82/100 and mean length increases by 13.11 steps versus 280k (95% interval [0.6585, 25.863]). Across all six checkpoints, 280k has the highest success count, lowest mean episode length, and highest mean reward; its choice is not based on training step or a single-metric maximum. The nonmonotonic 260k dip and 300k decline are explicit stability caveats pending untouched 200-seed confirmation.
